I will not use chemical fertilizer on this bean plot because legumes can fix their own nitrogen and any subsidized fertilizer I receive must go to my maize. I will spread manure from my animals to give the soil strength, plant the bean seeds I saved from last season, and rely on the rains without any pesticides or irrigation. My children and I will do most of the work, but I will hire about five days of labor from neighbors when the weeding and harvesting come all at once.
